        check(Api.echoNatBox(box).equals(box));
        check(Api.echoAgain(new NatBoxAgain(n(4), n(1))).equals(new NatBoxAgain(n(4), n(1))));
        check(Api.echoTextBox(new TextBox(greeting, n(0))).equals(new TextBox(greeting, n(0))));
        LeftBox left = Api.echoLeft(new LeftBox(n(5), n(2)));
        RightBox right = Api.echoRight(new RightBox(n(6), n(3)));
        check(left.equals(new LeftBox(n(5), n(2))));
        check(right.equals(new RightBox(n(6), n(3))));
        check(!LeftBox.class.equals(RightBox.class) && !LeftBox.class.equals(NatBox.class));
        NatBox[] specializedBoxes = Api.echoBoxes(boxes);
        check(specializedBoxes.length == 3 && specializedBoxes[2].value().equals(huge) && Api.echoBoxes(new NatBox[0]).length == 0);
        Option<NatBox[]> specializedOptional = Api.echoOptionalBoxes(Option.some(boxes));
        check(specializedOptional.isSome() && specializedOptional.value()[2].value().equals(huge));
        check(!Api.echoOptionalBoxes(Option.none()).isSome());
        check(Api.echoOptionalBoxes(Option.some(new NatBox[0])).value().length == 0);
        BigInteger[] specializedNats = Api.echoNats(new BigInteger[] {n(0), huge});
        check(specializedNats.length == 2 && specializedNats[1].equals(huge) && Api.echoNats(new BigInteger[0]).length == 0);
        Option<BigInteger> specializedNat = Api.echoOptionalNat(Option.some(huge));
        check(specializedNat.isSome() && specializedNat.value().equals(huge) && !Api.echoOptionalNat(Option.none()).isSome());
        check(rejected(() -> Api.echoLeft(new LeftBox(n(-1), n(0)))));
        check(rejected(() -> Api.echoOptionalBoxes(Option.some(new NatBox[] {null}))));
        check(rejected(() -> Api.echoOptionalNat(Option.some(n(-1)))));
        check(Api.echoLeft(new LeftBox(n(7), n(0))).value().equals(n(7)));
